stem.text: A ball of mass $2.0\,\text{kg}$ travels horizontally with a speed of $4.0\,\text{m s}^{-1}$. The ball collides with a wall and rebounds in the opposite direction with a speed of $2.8\,\text{m s}^{-1}$. The time of the collision is $150\,\text{ms}$.
What is the average force exerted on the wall?
